bib.title: Code Llama: Open Foundation Models for Code

read.skipped: Bias tables 21-25 (per-group sentiment scores) and qualitative example figures 17-22 skimmed only; not needed for method or main results.

question: Can a general-purpose LLM (Llama 2) be specialised into open code models with infilling, long-context and instruction-following abilities that are state of the art among open models?
hypothesis: Initialising from Llama 2 and applying a cascade of code training, infilling, long-context fine-tuning and instruction fine-tuning outperforms code-only training for a given budget.
contributions: Code Llama, Code Llama - Python and Code Llama - Instruct in 7B, 13B, 34B and 70B sizes, released under a permissive licence
Infilling (7B, 13B, 70B) via a multitask autoregressive plus causal infilling objective
Long context fine-tuning stage: 16,384-token sequences with RoPE base period raised from 10,000 to 1,000,000, stable up to 100K tokens
Instruction fine-tuning with a self-instruct set of unit-test-filtered question-test-solution triplets

method.summary: Llama 2 weights are further trained on 500B tokens (1T for 70B) of a code-heavy mix, optionally with a fill-in-the-middle objective, then fine-tuned for long context (RoPE base 1e6, 16,384-token sequences), and optionally specialised on 100B Python tokens or instruction-tuned on about 5B tokens. Evaluation is by pass@k on HumanEval, MBPP, APPS and MultiPL-E, plus infilling, long-context and safety benchmarks.
method.task: continued pretraining and fine-tuning of a decoder-only LLM for code generation and infilling

datasets.name: Code Llama code-heavy mix
datasets.size: 500B tokens (1T for 70B); mix 85% code, 8% natural language related to code, 7% natural language
datasets.source: near-deduplicated publicly available code; disk sizes 859 GB code, 78 GB NL about code, 3.5 TB NL
datasets.preprocessing: BPE with the Llama/Llama 2 tokenizer; infilling transform applied with probability 0.9

datasets.name: Python-heavy mix (Code Llama - Python)
datasets.split: Python 75% (3.69 epochs, 79 GB), code 10%, NL related to code 10%, NL 5%

datasets.name: Proprietary instruction data (Llama 2 RLHF V5)
datasets.size: thousands of SFT and millions of rejection sampling examples
datasets.source: Llama 2 instruction tuning dataset, multi-turn dialogues, helpfulness and safety

datasets.name: Self-instruct code set
datasets.size: about 14,000 question-tests-solution triplets (62,000 generated questions, about 52,000 after exact dedup)
datasets.source: questions from Llama 2 70B; tests and ten solutions per question from Code Llama 7B; first solution passing the tests kept

datasets.name: Rehearsal data
datasets.size: 6% code dataset and 2% natural language dataset inside the instruct mix

datasets.name: APPS
datasets.preprocessing: no fine-tuning on the APPS training set

datasets.name: LCC-balanced
datasets.size: 548 Python, 412 Java and 512 C# data points
datasets.source: resampled from LCC (Guo et al., 2023) validation and test sets with equalised file-size distribution
datasets.preprocessing: non-LCFT models get prompts truncated to 4,000 tokens

datasets.name: TruthfulQA, ToxiGen, BOLD
datasets.source: Lin et al. 2022; Hartvigsen et al. 2022; Dhamala et al. 2021
datasets.preprocessing: BOLD: Hinduism and Atheism prompts excluded

models.name: Code Llama
models.init_from: Llama 2 weights of the same size
models.tokenizer: BPE, Llama/Llama 2 tokenizer (SentencePiece) extended with four special infilling tokens
models.context: trained at 4,096 then 16,384 tokens; inference tested to 100,000 tokens

models.name: Code Llama - Python
models.init_from: Llama 2, then 500B Code Llama tokens, then 100B Python tokens

models.name: Code Llama - Instruct
models.init_from: Code Llama (70B from Code Llama - Python 70B)

models.name: Unnatural Code Llama
models.init_from: Code Llama - Python 34B fine-tuned on 15,000 unnatural instructions; not released

other.pretraining: 2T tokens, including only 80B tokens of code

models.name: StarCoder, code-cushman-001, GPT-3.5, GPT-4, PaLM, PaLM-Coder, PaLM 2-S, CodeGen-Multi, CodeGeeX, InCoder, SantaCoder

training.objective: autoregressive next-token; for 7B/13B/70B a multitask objective mixing autoregressive and causal infilling, applied to documents with probability 0.9, half PSM and half SPM format
training.lr: 3e-4 (13B), 1.5e-4 (34B and 70B), original Llama 2 learning rate retained for 7B (value not stated); 1e-4 for Python fine-tuning; 2e-5 for long context fine-tuning
training.lr_schedule: cosine, final learning rate 1/30th of peak
training.batch_size: 4M tokens (sequences of 4,096); instruct 524,288 tokens; LCFT 2M tokens for 7B and 13B, 1M tokens for 34B
training.steps: LCFT 10,000 gradient steps by default; 11,000 for 34B; 3,000 for Code Llama 7B
training.epochs: Table 1: code 2.03, NL related to code 1.39, NL 0.01 (Code Llama); Python 3.69 (Python stage)
training.tokens: 500B (1T for 70B) code training; +100B Python; about 5B instruct; LCFT 20B (Fig 2)
training.regularisation: rehearsal data in instruct stage (6% code, 2% natural language)
training.hardware: A100-80GB on Meta's Research Super Cluster
training.compute: 1400K GPU hours for all 12 Code Llama models; 228.55 tCO2eq

other.stage_tokens_Fig2: 500B code, 100B Python, 20B long context, 5B instruct (figure labels 100B, 500B, 20B, 20B, 5B)
other.70B_pipeline_Fig8: 500B, 20B, 100B, 260M labels; Only base 70B trained with LCFT
other.infilling_tokenisation: implicit leading space suppressed for middle and suffix; four special tokens added

inference.decoding: pass@1 greedy; pass@10 and pass@100 nucleus sampling p=0.95; safety evals temperature 0.1 and top-p 0.9
inference.temperature: 0.8 for pass@10/100 on HumanEval and MBPP (Table 2); 0.6 on APPS; 0.1 in Table 5; Fig 6 sweeps {0.1, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8}
inference.prompting: HumanEval zero-shot, MBPP 3-shot (Table 2); APPS two-shot; instruct MBPP zero-shot with [PYTHON] tags

metrics.name: pass@k
metrics.definition: fraction of problems with at least one of k samples passing unit tests

metrics.name: exact match and BLEU
metrics.definition: single-line completion on LCC-balanced and infilling

metrics.name: key retrieval accuracy
metrics.definition: correct two-digit value after an inserted function in long Python prompts, 64 examples per length/position

metrics.name: perplexity
metrics.definition: over 4M tokens of large source files (>=50kB) from validation data

metrics.name: TruthfulQA, ToxiGen, BOLD
metrics.definition: percent truthful and informative; percent toxic; mean VADER sentiment

eval.protocol: Single runs; no seeds or confidence intervals reported; 7B and 13B ablations pre-LCFT.

availability.weights: released under a custom Llama 2 style permissive licence for research and commercial use
availability.data: not released; training data stated to be the same as Llama 2 with different weights; dataset described only in Table 1

evidence.quote: we obtained best results when retaining the original learning rate of the Llama 2 base model

results.claim: Code Llama - Instruct 70B reaches the highest HumanEval pass@1 among the family.
results.table: Table 2, row Code Llama - Instruct 70B, column HumanEval pass@1
results.note: Abstract says up to 67% on HumanEval

results.claim: Code Llama - Python 70B reaches the highest MBPP pass@1.
results.table: Table 2, row Code Llama - Python 70B, column MBPP pass@1

results.claim: Code Llama 7B (HumanEval pass@1) roughly matches Llama 2 70B after 500B code tokens.
results.setup: Greedy, zero-shot, Code Llama 7B with FIM and LCFT
results.table: Table 2, row Code Llama 7B, column HumanEval pass@1

results.claim: Infilling training costs 0.6 points (7B) and 1.1 points (13B) on average across HumanEval and MBPP pass@k.
results.setup: 7B and 13B, 500B code tokens, before LCFT, temperature 0.1
results.quote: The 7B model loses 0.6 percentage points on average across HumanEval and MBPP pass@1, pass@10 and pass@100 scores if trained with an infilling objective, while the 13B model loses 1.1 percentage points.

results.claim: Long context fine-tuning slightly reduces short-context benchmark scores.
results.quote: an average decrease of 0.52 percentage points on HumanEval pass@1 and 1.9 points on MBPP for the pass@1 metric

results.claim: Starting from Llama 2 beats training from scratch on the same code mix: the scratch model reaches Code Llama 7B's mid-training loss only at the end.
results.quote: At the end of training, the loss of the model trained from scratch is equal to the loss of Code Llama 7B at about half of its training (with 240B less training tokens).

results.claim: Self-instruct data improves HumanEval for 7B instruct and makes MBPP zero-shot format following reliable at 13B.
results.table: Table 8, row 13B SI check, column MBPP zero-shot

results.claim: Perplexity keeps decreasing beyond the 16,384-token fine-tuning length, up to 100K tokens.
results.setup: Large source files >=50kB, 4M tokens, all sizes
results.quote: Perplexity decreases for up to 100K tokens for all Code Llama sizes.

results.claim: Without changing RoPE base period, LCFT fails to retrieve far keys at 8,000 context; frequency scaling 1/4 fails at longer lengths while theta=1e6 extrapolates.
results.metric: key retrieval accuracy at 24,000 context, key position 0.4

results.claim: Code Llama 70B reaches the best average multilingual HumanEval pass@1.
results.table: Table 4, row Code Llama 70B, column Average

results.claim: Instruct 34B TruthfulQA (true and informative) rises from 34.64 to 47.37 and ToxiGen toxicity falls from 17.62 to 0.00.
results.quote: truthfulness (from 34.64 to 47.37 for 34B) and toxicity (from 17.62 to 0.00 for 34B)

results.claim: Long context fine-tuning improves LCC-balanced single-line completion (Python 34B EM 42.52 to 44.89).
results.table: Table 7, row Code Llama 34B, columns EM

limits: Table 2 Llama 2 MBPP pass@100 values (34B 77.6, 70B 83.1) differ from Table 10 (34B 83.1, 70B 85.5); Table 2 Llama 2 70B shows 83.1, Table 10 shows 85.5.
Random-span infilling in SPM format degrades because token healing was not implemented.
LCFT and infilling both cost short-context benchmark score; authors judge the trade-off worthwhile.
LCC data points are included in the code training data (footnote 2); CodeXGLUE overlap possible.
Key retrieval declines beyond 16K tokens; Instruct 7B fails to retrieve keys at the start for 16K prompts.
Helpfulness comparison uses only the Llama 2 reward model, taken 'with a grain of salt'.
No seeds, error bars or significance tests; vocabulary, layer counts and precision not stated; data not released.
